name: get_option_chain
description: Retrieves option chain data for an underlying symbol, including latest trade, quote, implied volatility, and greeks for each contract. The response can be very large. Use the type (call/put), strike_price_gte/lte, expiration_date, and limit parameters to narrow results.

underlying_symbol.description: The financial instrument on which an option contract is based or derived.

feed.description: The source feed of the data. `opra` is the official OPRA feed, `indicative` is a free indicative feed where trades are delayed and quotes are modified. Default: `opra` if the user has a subscription, otherwise `indicative`.

limit.description:
Number of maximum snapshots to return in a response.
The limit applies to the total number of data points, not the number per symbol!
Use `next_page_token` to fetch the next set of responses.

updated_since.description:
Filter to snapshots that were updated since this timestamp, meaning that the timestamp of the trade or the quote is greater than or equal to this value.
Format: RFC-3339 or YYYY-MM-DD. If missing, all values are returned.

page_token.description: The pagination token from which to continue. The value to pass here is returned in specific requests when more data is available, usually because of a response result limit.

type.description: Filter contracts by the type (call or put).

strike_price_gte.description: Filter contracts with strike price greater than or equal to the specified value.

strike_price_lte.description: Filter contracts with strike price less than or equal to the specified value.

expiration_date.description: Filter contracts by the exact expiration date (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

expiration_date_gte.description: Filter contracts with expiration date greater than or equal to the specified date.

expiration_date_lte.description: Filter contracts with expiration date less than or equal to the specified date.

root_symbol.description: Filter contracts by the root symbol.
